children: The conclave will bring together sustainability leaders, policymakers, climate-tech founders and industry experts to examine how businesses can turn sustainability commitments into measurable value

: BW Businessworld will host the 9th edition of the Sustainable World Conclave tomorrow, 17  September 2026, at the Novotel, Andheri, bringing together corporate sustainability leaders, policymakers, climate-tech founders and industry experts under the theme "From Ambition to Advantage." The day-long conclave will examine how Indian enterprises are moving sustainability commitments from statements of intent to sources of measurable business value.

The conclave opens with an address by Dr. Annurag Batra, Chairman & Editor-in-Chief, BW Businessworld and Founder, Exchange4Media, on "Sustainability Beyond Action," setting the tone for a day of conversations on data, capital, supply chains and the next frontier of corporate sustainability.

Through the day, four flagship panel discussions will anchor the agenda. The first, "AI for Sustainability: Can We Trust the Data Enough to Act on It?", brings together sustainability leaders from Reliance Industries, TÜV SÜD AG, Axis Bank, Cipla and Infosys to discuss where artificial intelligence is delivering measurable returns across energy, operations and ESG reporting, and what separates a promising pilot from an enterprise-wide deployment.

The second, "Climate Tech at Scale: What Does India Inc. Need Beyond the Pilot?", features leaders from ICICI Bank, Voltas, Dalmia Bharat and HCLTech in conversation on why climate-tech pilots often stall before procurement and what proof points are needed for enterprises to commit at scale.

Later in the day, "Sustainability vs Supply Chain Resilience: What Happens When Cost Comes First?" will see leaders from TVS Motors, Colgate-Palmolive India and Persistent Systems debate whether resilient, low-carbon supply chains reduce long-term cost and risk, or remain a trade-off enterprises must continually negotiate. The day's final panel, "What Comes After Net Zero? The Next Corporate

Sustainability Frontier," brings together sustainability chiefs from JK Organisation, Aditya Birla Group, Godrej Industries Group and Siemens to look beyond carbon at water, biodiversity, resource security and circularity as the next material risks for business.

The agenda also includes a fireside conversation between Prabodha Acharya, Chief Sustainability Officer, JSW Group, and Noor Fatima Warsia, Group Editorial Director, BW Businessworld, on corporate accountability for value-chain emissions; industry case studies from Mahindra Group and Hindalco Industries on decarbonisation at scale; a partner presentation from GIFT City, Gandhinagar on net-zero urban planning; and a Startup Spotlight session showcasing five climate-tech ventures — Flytta Green, ParyAI Solutions, Varaha, Promethean Energy and Indra — building solutions across fleet electrification, water treatment, carbon removal and industrial energy efficiency.

The conclave will close with a keynote from Deepak Thakur, MD & CEO, Hinduja Renewables, on leadership in a fast-scaling ecosystem, before the day culminates in the BW Sustainable World Awards 2026 and a celebratory dinner.

BW Businessworld is one of India's leading business media platforms, publishing incisive journalism and hosting flagship industry conclaves and award platforms across sectors including sustainability, technology and entrepreneurship.
